blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY—Over 130 former rebels and community members will manage a pili seedling production nursery in Mondragon, Northern Samar, as part of the government’s efforts to provide livelihood opportunities and support the reintegration of former insurgents into mainstream society. The nursery, located at Kauswagan Village, was formally inaugurated on Nov. 20 through a partnership between the Office of the Presidential Adviser on Peace, Reconciliation and Unity (OPAPRU) and the Northern Samar provincial government. OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen Sarmiento and Gov. Harris Christopher Ongchuan led the inauguration of the facility, envisioned as the starting point of a larger agricultural enterprise that will […]...
